test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Better
solution:
The solution is **Inferior**,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM for "**Better**" is Inferior. 
 
• Better - More desirable, satisfactory. 
 
 
• *For example: "We are hoping for a better result this time."*
 
 
 
• *​*Inferior - Lower in rank, status, or quality.
 
 
• *For example: "The schooling in inner-city area was inferior to that in the rest of the country."*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *Antonyms:*

 
 
• Antonyms is the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
 
• For example :- Antonym of *good is bad, little is more.*
 
 
 
• *​*Antonym of **Brave **is coward.
 
• Antonym of **Homely **is uncomfortable.
 
• Antonym of **Fitter **is unfit.
 
 

2c
